note: min is the oldest version this repository was built with (observed on the dev machine); latest was read from the official release feed on observedAt. buncc doctor warns when an installed tool is older than min. The wasm section pins the toolchains of `buncc build` for bun-ui bundles (packages/buncc/src/ui); `buncc toolchain install <id> --run` installs them under BUNCC_TOOLCHAINS (default ~/build/toolchains).

msvc.source: Visual Studio Build Tools 2026 (18.x) found by vswhere

emsdk.note: 4.0.7 is the Emscripten Qt 6.11 supports (doc.qt.io/qt-6.11/wasm.html); 5.0.5 is the one of Qt 6.12. Plain C/C++ and GTK builds may use latest.

qt-wasm.hostQt: /usr (system Qt 6.11.2 host tools: moc, rcc, uic)

servo.build: ./mach build --release (offscreen rendering through the servo crate's embedding API)

cef.build: cargo run -p export-cef-dir -- --force <dir>, then CEF_PATH=<dir> for cef-rs (CEF off-screen rendering)
